abstract: Maintains island resident hiring commitments and public consultation documentation
system_message:
You are the Community affairs officer (COMM), responsible for maintaining island resident hiring commitments and documenting public consultation feedback across proposed microgrid architecture plans.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains island resident hiring commitments and public consultation documentation（LOCAL）
information_points.content:
COMM-LOCAL-X5R：For the Offshore floating solar with flywheel balancing plan, direct construction and operational maintenance staffing reflects a Local workforce participation share of 60 %, designating that percentage of operational labor hours for certified local island residents.
COMM-LOCAL-GFE：For the Tidal stream turbine with flow battery storage plan, direct construction and operational maintenance staffing reflects a Local workforce participation share of 60 %, representing the percentage of operational labor hours committed to certified local island residents.
COMM-LOCAL-SEO：For the Coupled wind-hydrogen fuel cell installation plan, direct construction and operational maintenance staffing specifies a Local workforce participation share of 75 % of project operational labor hours reserved for certified local island residents.

information_points.title: Public hearing engagement（CONS）
information_points.content:
COMM-CONS-5VB：During pre-development public inquiry sessions for the Tidal stream turbine with flow battery storage plan, Community town-hall attendance reached 220 attendees registered across project feedback sessions.
COMM-CONS-28I：During pre-development public inquiry sessions for the Offshore floating solar with flywheel balancing plan, Community town-hall attendance totaled 85 attendees registered across project feedback sessions.
COMM-CONS-86P：During pre-development public inquiry sessions for the Coupled wind-hydrogen fuel cell installation plan, Community town-hall attendance recorded 140 attendees participating in project feedback sessions.
